title: Familial Form of Carotid Web: a Doppler Ultrasound Study
official: Family Screening for Internal Carotid Diaphragm Dysplasia (Carotid WEB): a Doppler Ultrasound Study
summary: There is no evidence of familial forms of carotid web. The aim of this study is to determine the prevalence of carotid web among relatives of patient with carotid web using carotid doppler ultrasound.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Carotid Web index patients:

* Patients with carotid web confirmed by CT angiogram (CTA) of cervical arteries or digital substraction angiogram (DSA).
* At least one first degree relative aged younger than 65 years old.

Relatives patients :

\- First degree relatives of patient with diagnosed carotid web.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persons placed under judicial protection or under another protection status
* Pregnant or breastfeeding woman.
